name: @maradocs/cloudflare
description: Cloudflare-native MaraDocs: publish static HTML reports to a Worker backed by D1 and R2.

DB.description: D1 database for MaraDocs metadata: repositories, documents, versions, API key hashes, sessions and the audit log. Created for you (named after the Worker unless you rename it); the schema is applied automatically on first request.

BUCKET.description: R2 bucket that stores the published report files (one object per version). Created for you; keep it private — the Worker serves files with access checks.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Optional claim password. While no account exists, creating the first account in the dashboard requires it, so nobody else can claim your deployment before you do. Ignored once an account exists; it is never used to sign in. Use a long random value, e.g. `openssl rand -base64 24`.
